description: This is a server-side JavaScript file for a Node.js application that sets up and manages an HTTP server, handles environment variables, manages PID files for single-instance enforcement, and integrates with MongoDB via Mongoose. It includes startup routines, error handling, and process signal handling.

methods.name: logListening
methods.description: Logs the server listening address and port.

methods.name: ensurePidFileGuard
methods.description: Checks for existing PID file and active process to prevent multiple instances.

methods.name: writePidFile
methods.description: Writes the current process ID to the PID file.

methods.name: removePidFile
methods.description: Removes the PID file if it exists.

methods.name: startServerStrict
methods.description: Starts the HTTP server, manages startup logs, error handling, and graceful shutdown.
